analysis_summary: The text describes a 2026 AI risk landscape with frontier labs, government regulators, media, experts, public voices, malicious deepfake actors, sockpuppet accounts, and affected companies. The simulation should model how these actors react to AI incidents, policy decisions, and lab actions on social media.
